articles.summary: Forge is a pluggable, open-source pipeline that runs in CI to generate SDKs, CLIs, and documentation directly from API definitions.
articles.title: Introducing Forge: the open source pipeline for generating SDKs, CLIs, docs, and more

articles.summary: New Cloudflare Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation service uses OpenAI Daybreak models to find, block, and fix software vulnerabilities—often before security teams even know there is a problem
articles.title: Cloudflare Partners with OpenAI Daybreak Models to Redefine Vulnerability Management with AI-Powered Edge Defense

articles.summary: A modern storefront can look healthy while malicious JavaScript quietly siphons revenue, hijacks clicks, or rewrites analytics. See how Cloudflare's machine learning models surface evasive client-side attacks for analyst investigation.
articles.title: When scanners miss the attack: how Cloudflare Client-Side Security protects storefronts

articles.summary: Strategic partnership strengthens the security and resilience of digital infrastructure for European businesses. Deutsche Telekom expands its enterprise portfolio with Cloudflare security solutions, creating a leading infrastructure channel partnership in Europe.
articles.title: Cloudflare and Deutsche Telekom Join Forces for a Secure and Resilient Internet

articles.summary: Cloudflare’s new certificate authority will support MTC issuance at scale.
articles.title: Building a post-quantum certificate authority with Merkle Tree Certificates

articles.summary: Misconfiguring Turnstile by skipping backend validation leaves sites exposed to bots. Turnstile Spin fixes incomplete setups by using your preferred AI coding agent to wire up server-side verification.
articles.title: Agents can now set up your website’s security with Turnstile Spin

articles.summary: New controls and recommended settings go live today, allowing publishers and businesses to independently control how their content is used across search, AI training, and AI agents. Leading mixed use crawlers already offer or are building controls that honor these choices.
articles.title: Cloudflare Helps End the Search-or-AI-Training Tradeoff

articles.summary: Cloudflare Containers now start 6x faster, let your agent choose each sandbox's image and instance type at runtime, and support filesystem snapshots in public beta, all controlled from a Durable Object.
articles.title: Cloudflare Containers, rebuilt to scale agent sandboxes

articles.summary: Workers now enables Node.js compatibility by default, supports applications up to 64 mebibytes, and adds a URL-based module registry with import.meta, lazy compilation, shared code caches, and clearer errors.
articles.title: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility

articles.summary: Cloudflare AI Gateway now features a model router that evaluates request complexity using an edge-deployed classifier to select the optimal model. By balancing expected output quality against token costs, organizations can dramatically cut AI spend while maintaining performance.
articles.title: Cut your AI spend with AI Gateway's Auto Router

articles.summary: We are expanding access to Cloudforce One's Threat Events Platform to every Cloudflare account and introducing Threat Signals. Threat Signals automatically parses open-source threat reporting, extracts structured indicators, and connects threat context directly to your WAF rules.
articles.title: Introducing Threat Signals: agentic skills for open-source threat intelligence, free for every Cloudflare account

articles.summary: Cloudflare's global network is immense but not limitless. As we look for small ways to trim our resource usage, we sometimes get lucky and we can cut significantly more. Here’s how we reduced one of our Pingora-based service's RAM usage with statistics.
articles.title: Saving another 100TB of RAM with math (and Rust)

articles.summary: With the new experimental support for the Emscripten target in Rust Workers, many previously unsupported Rust libraries and applications can now be built and deployed directly to Cloudflare’s global Workers platform, including upcoming support for Tokio async.
articles.title: Supporting native Rust in Workers with the new Emscripten target for wasm-bindgen

articles.summary: We are releasing cf, our new command-line tool that mirrors the entire Cloudflare API and supports programmatic TypeScript configuration. We are also open-sourcing Forge, our internal SDK generator.
articles.title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API

articles.summary: You can now use built-in error monitoring in Cloudflare Workers to group production failures and send stack traces, logs, traces, and application context directly to a coding agent to investigate further and open a pull request.
articles.title: Detect and send production issues straight to your agent

articles.summary: Vinext 1.0 graduates from an AI experiment to a production-ready framework, letting developers run Next.js apps on Vite. This release brings advanced cache warming, broader compatibility, and an automated testing pipeline.
articles.title: Next.js applications, powered by Vite: introducing Vinext 1.0

articles.summary: Cloudflare Registrar’s new search delivers fast, transparent results across 420+ extensions using Workers, Durable Objects, and WebSockets. Its expanded API and cf CLI also let agents search, register, and transfer domains.
articles.title: Simplifying domains for people and agents

articles.summary: Cloudflare’s AI Gateway, Ceramic.ai, Stocktwits, and more are using the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway today to charge agents for access to tokens, APIs, and MCP tools. U.S.-based sellers can now app
articles.title: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402

articles.summary: Cloudflare learns the structure of your HTTP requests and identifies deviations. You can add a positive security layer that helps reduce attack surface as AI makes it easier for attackers to generate and vary payloads.
articles.title: Enforce positive security with Cloudflare Application Profiles

articles.summary: Cloudflare introduces an adaptive security framework connecting risk discovery, agent governance, runtime protection, and AI-powered response in a continuous learning loop.
articles.title: Adaptive application security for the AI era: how Cloudflare connects code, traffic, and intelligence to stop attacks

articles.summary: AI Gateway User Insights now adds task, model, turn, and user categories to help teams understand AI adoption and make better model decisions. This is available free to AI Gateway users.
articles.title: Identify AI model overuse with User Insights

articles.summary: Cloudflare is giving site owners a way to stay discoverable while disallowing AI training. New controls and an Accountable designation establish a shared model with Apple, Google, and Microsoft.
articles.title: Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training

articles.summary: You can now scope access to individual Workers and assign narrower Developer Platform roles, so teammates, CI tokens, and agents get only the access they need to debug, deploy, or monitor safely.
articles.title: Give every teammate and agent the right level of access to your Workers

articles.summary: We’ve updated Kitesurf, our Workers-based browser for AI agents, with WebMCP support, improved DOM performance, and terminal-based rendering.
articles.title: The road to the agentic browser: A Kitesurf update

articles.summary: External security researchers at Accomplish identified a vulnerability in Cloudflare Containers that could expose residual disk data from previous workloads. We explain how the issue worked, how we investigated it, and the steps we took to remediate it.
articles.title: How Cloudflare addressed a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability in Containers

articles.summary: 1.1.1.1 now validates DNSSEC signatures using NIST’s post-quantum ML-DSA-44 algorithm. Here is how we manage 2,420-byte signatures and downgrade risks at scale.
articles.title: 1.1.1.1 now supports post-quantum DNSSEC, all 2,420 bytes of it

articles.summary: We built a WAF tester that adapted each request based on what the WAF blocked or passed. This helped us explore variations that a fixed test might miss. We ran it across six attack categories on an authorized staging environment and discovered detection gaps worth fixing. Here’s how the loop worked, what got through, and what we did about it.
articles.title: We tested our own WAF with frontier AI models. Here’s what we found

articles.summary: EmDash 1.0 is a stable, open source CMS built for Astro, with agent-friendly workflows, secure sandboxed plugins, and a decentralized registry that keeps publishers in control.
articles.title: EmDash 1.0: the stable CMS with a secure plugin registry

articles.summary: Cloudflare is open-sourcing the BEACON dataset, making billions of anonymized Real User Monitoring (RUM) performance records publicly available on Google BigQuery.
articles.title: How fast is the web? Explore billions of real-user measurements with BEACON

articles.summary: Twelve years after launching Universal SSL, Cloudflare is applying to become a certificate authority.
articles.title: Building a certificate authority for the whole Internet

articles.summary: This week, Cloudflare's Impact programs will reach $100 million in donated services. This milestone means that thousands of entities including journalists, civil society, state and local governments, election management bodies, and public schools are being protected from cyberattacks.
articles.title: Cloudflare Impact reaches $100 million in donations

articles.summary: Now SpaceXAI users have another way to run AI agents in environments they control, while Cloudflare expands the infrastructure powering the next generation of agentic software
articles.title: Cloudflare Expands Support for AI Coding Agents with Cursor Cloud Agents on Cloudflare Sandboxes

articles.summary: We’re building CryptoLabe, an internal AI-powered tool that discovers cryptography across our codebase, surfaces dependencies, and helps us progress toward a full post-quantum migration by 2029. Here’s what we’ve learned so far.
articles.title: Using AI to chart a course for our post-quantum migration

articles.summary: Cloudflare is launching The Cold Start, a startup competition giving five early-stage companies five minutes on stage at Cloudflare Connect.
articles.title: Introducing The Cold Start: pitch your startup live at Cloudflare Connect

articles.summary: The Internet is changing more today than at any point since Cloudflare launched back on September 27, 2010. As automated traffic surpasses human activity, we reflect on the rise of AI agents, new creators, and how we can help build a fair, sustainable future for the web.
articles.title: Cloudflare’s 2026 Annual Founders’ Letter

articles.summary: Since joining Cloudflare, VoidZero has delivered more than 80 releases that drastically speed up JavaScript compilation, linting, and testing.
articles.title: Four months of VoidZero at Cloudflare: making the open-source JavaScript toolchain faster for all humans and agents

articles.summary: Could we get more cache space with the same hardware? We prototyped compression inside Cloudflare's cache to find out.
articles.title: How we could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora

articles.summary: A sophisticated attacker with a quantum computer can exploit a protocol design flaw to downgrade post-quantum IPsec tunnels to classical crypto. We helped the IETF develop a transcript authentication extension to prevent these attacks.
articles.title: Preventing quantum downgrade attacks against IPsec

articles.summary: Vary support is now available in Cache Rules on every plan. You can normalize known negotiation headers, pass exact values through to the origin when those small differences matter, or bypass cache when the variation is too unpredictable.
articles.title: We just shipped support for the ugliest part of HTTP: Vary

articles.summary: Cloudflare has added visibility into post-quantum (PQ) encryption in TLS 1.3 directly into HTTP Analytics, Log Explorer, and Logpush. Learn how to make sure your domain is protected with PQ encryption.
articles.title: Is your domain using post-quantum encryption? Now you can see for yourself

articles.summary: Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically. Security teams can now design event-driven logic to revoke risky file shares and send webhooks without manual intervention.
articles.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB

articles.summary: Automatic Key Exchange probes TLS 1.3-capable customer origins to learn which key agreement algorithms they support. We then lead with the most secure algorithm when connecting to the origin, preferring post-quantum connections wherever the origin supports it.
articles.title: Automatic Key Exchange: faster, post-quantum secure origin handshakes for 45 billion daily connections (and counting)

articles.summary: Worker Previews gives every branch its own URL, configuration, state, and observability, so you and your agents can test changes in parallel without affecting production.
articles.title: Introducing Worker Previews: Isolated preview environments for every change your agent makes

articles.summary: Automated certificates for everyone, built for today, and hardened for the era of quantum computing
articles.title: Cloudflare Announces Public Certificate Authority for the Post-Quantum Web

articles.summary: Pay Per Use is now in beta. AI companies report when they use publishers’ content, and Cloudflare handles billing, payouts, and reporting, so our customers are paid according to use.
articles.title: Pay Per Use: when AI uses your work, you should get paid

articles.summary: Python Workers allow developers to run Python web frameworks and AI orchestration libraries natively in the Cloudflare Workers runtime. You can seamlessly integrate with Cloudflare's ecosystem including D1, R2, and Workers AI without writing any JavaScript glue code.
articles.title: Python Workers are now generally available

articles.summary: Use production traffic and security signals to prioritize findings, prepare edge mitigations when safe, and propose code patches. By combining WAF data with OpenAI Daybreak models, Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation helps teams identify and patch the most critical threats first.
articles.title: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models

articles.summary: More than half the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated, and AI agents are the fastest-growing part of it. We're giving site owners the tools to see who's visiting, decide who gets in, and charge for access.
articles.title: The Internet has a second audience
